text:
emma: FYI @channel were moving the JS/TS SDK to strict TypeScript types as the default. This improves DX and catches runtime mismatches earlier. Short compatibility window included. :sparkles:

toby: What exactly changes? Any breaking types?

emma: Were tightening function signatures (no implicit any for responses, generics for streaming frames, stronger union types for errors). Most callers that already use TS will be fine; plain-JS consumers can keep using the published commonjs build for 45 days.

indra: Eng details: new package @redwood/sdk-ts v3.0.0-rc introduces stricter declarations. We ship both: `dist/esm` (strict d.ts) and `dist/compat` (looser d.ts). CI will run typechecks against a set of representative repos for 45 days. We'll also publish an opt-out flag `ALLOW_LOOSE_TYPES=true` for 45 days.

kevin: Docs tasks: migration guide, examples converting `client.on('message', ...)` to typed handlers, update quickstarts, and add a top-level banner on the JS SDK page. ETA for first draft: tomorrow noon.

sales: Need a short customer-facing blurb and a 2-line TL;DR for deals: "No action for TS users; JS users should install `@redwood/sdk-js-compat` or upgrade within 45 days."

emma: Timeline recap:
- Today: announce + publish RC and compatibility bundle.
- 45 days: strict types become default in main published package; compat bundle remains but marked deprecated.
- 180 days: compat bundle deprecated in docs and will emit a warning in builds.
- 365 days: compat bundle removed.

toby: Migration example for docs:
```ts
// loose (old)
client.on('message', (m) => console.log(m.body))

// strict (new)
client.on('message', (m: RedwoodMessage) => {
  // m.text: string, m.meta?: Record<string, any>
  console.log(m.text)
})
```
Notes: well include codemods for common patterns.

indra: Ops note: Dedicated/Private will get compat builds for 12 months; we will add build-time warnings in the runtime image when loose types are used.

docs-bot: Published: docs PR #4400 by kevin - "js: strict types migration guide + compat bundle (WIP)" (automated).

kevin: Action items: I'll own the migration guide and codemod, toby will run the typecheck jobs and surface failures, sales will prep the customer blurb. Posting RFC once PR merges. :thumbsup:
